<string name="ui_47">"Choose a folder to see all its .gba games. Tap Refresh after adding files. For covers, place Juego.png or Juego.jpg next to Juego.gba, or tap ⋯ on a card to choose an image. Open an uncompressed .gba file. Bruma GBA remembers your last game.

Save from the game menu. Use Pause to export a .lcsave backup and import it on another phone with the exact same ROM.

Returning home keeps the session paused. If Android closes the app, in-game saves remain, but the current moment is not saved.

Use RPG Maker · Experimental to import the folder of an RPG Maker XP game. Bruma copies it into its private storage and leaves the original unchanged. Compatibility varies by game.

Online play is not available yet."</string>
